title: Índice Praticidade 2026.1 (Praticidade Index 2026.1)
description: Open data from the Praticidade Index 2026.1: everyday walkable convenience (services infrastructure within walking distance) for 806 areas in 10 cities in Brazil and Portugal, with 10 thematic rankings published in 81 city-ranking slices. Values frozen on 15 July 2026 and not revised. Files are the official CSV and JSON downloads, unmodified. Methodology: https://praticidade.com/metodologia
